notes.title: Update 9/21/2025
notes.content:
Who wanted this to be easy? Yes? You? Well...


Minor tuning on all bosses to keep them in line with player progression
Additional weapon trail options for improved visuals
Bug fix for audio stutters when repeatedly hitting the same enemy

notes.title: Update 9/14/2025
notes.content:
Lame, exhausting, but necessary update... But now it's done. I can has cookie? 


Finished build system
Resized textures for small props, reducing VRAM usage. If you have a 6GB or less GPU, let me know how it works!
Tuned move speed of various enemies
Dependency updates on everything from Unity to Visual Studio to

notes.title: Update 9/7/2025
notes.content:
Woohooo - build server transition seems to have gone without any issues :) 


Updated lighting effects based on user feedback
Added additional attacks to spiders
Improved and automated build system - probably more exciting for us than you :P

notes.title: Update 8/31/2025
notes.content:
Making steady progress :) This time we moved to a new build system, improved performance when many enemies are on the screen, and fixed a few minor bugs...


Fixed unkillable fire traps
Adjusted projectile speeds and turn
Improved enemy animation caching
Fixed collider issue on plants 
Made fourth boss selectable in all menus

notes.title: Update 8/24/2025
notes.content: Looks like we finally figured out the crashes introduced in the last release. It had nothing to do with Unity 6.2, even though that was the most likely, but instead with the most recent VisualStudio upgrades... Yay

notes.title: Update 8/17/2025
notes.content:
Another long weekend, another good migration. We're now on the latest Unity 6.2 release and seeing an amazing speedup of about -11%... 


Made things slower by upgrading Unity...
Fixed green guy jittery bug (yes, I know how that sounds)
Integrated several textures into bundles, reducing load times on slower systems by up to 40%

notes.title: Update 8/10/2025
notes.content:
Wow, only 8pm today! No midnight deadline, no evil school teachers breathing down my back... Oh wait.. I wasn't supposed to say that, was I?


4th boss unlocked :)
Fixed minor issue with enemy responsiveness

notes.title: Updates 8/3/2025
notes.content:
Another weekend, another release! What else can I say - my life is really that exciting :)


 Upgraded Unity to latest supported release 
 Fixed minor turn-speed bug on large enemies
 Balanced weapons on higher levels
 Improved performance on AMD GPUs (again)
 Improved controller support

notes.title: Update 7/28/2025
notes.content:
Ha, it's still technically the weekend where I'm at! 


 Fixed a Unity shader bug... ARGH
 Other stuff I'm too tired to remember

notes.title: Update 7/20/2025
notes.content:
Alright, this update is a good one - the new enemy nav code makes them significantly more challenging to approach and the cheering now seems more logical. 


 Improved enemy navigation
 Improved enemy cheering animations
 Fixed attack distance of the green guys
 More armor choices!

notes.title: Update 7/13/2025
notes.content:
It's already been a week again? I just finished cooking some chili, with beans of course. I also cleaned the bathroom, did laundry, and... oh wait, yeah, game! 


 Navmesh performance improvements when lots of enemies are on screen
 Animation twitchiness resolved when frame rates drop
 Performance improvements on AMD GPUs
 Fixed random crash when exiting menu via escape
 Boss 4 improvements

notes.title: Update 7/6/2025
notes.content:
This update brings a few small improvements


 Improved UI on smaller screens
 More Place names
 More Audio clips for enemies
 Improved turning with mouse controls

notes.title: Update 6/29/2025
notes.content:
More performance improvements! Wooooo! This time we focused on loading times which could be quite long on slower devices. So for those with harddrives, running games of a SDCard on your steamdeck, or who's SSDs are connected via carrier wombats, let us know how we did!


 Loading performance improvements
 Collider improvements in the swamp rooms - this should keep players from getting stuck on vegetation when running away from the skeletons. You know, you're not supposed to run away from them anyway, right? You're a strong confident woman who doesn't need to smoke... 
 Reverted menu change per player feedback
 Removed obvious Friends references
 Added 2 new weapons

notes.title: Update 6/22/2025
notes.content:
Woooohooooo our smallest update to date! It's amazing, it's awesome, it's simply the ... the ... the spelling error in the main menu.


 Fixed spelling error in main menu
 That's it
 No really
 I swear. I've been traveling this last week and haven't had time
 Really, just a typo
 Go away!

notes.title: Update 6/15/2025
notes.content:
Happy HU-dad day! 


 Reverted audio changes per popular demand - we'll try once more next week or so based on the feedback we received
 Museum fixes for the 4th bully
 Improvements to accuracy of mouse controllers 
 Individual HU-man audio effects! Finally!

notes.title: Update 6/8/2025
notes.content:
Another week, another step closer to the Steamdeck. I finally got a mini PC installed with it so I can ssh into the system to gather logs and stats easier. Almost there! 


 Museum improvements
 Balancing of enemies - you know the three I mean...
 Fourth boss is almost ready!
 Steamdeck performance improvements
 Fixed audio bug at the end of the second boss battle

notes.title: Update 6/1/2025
notes.content:
More changes for the Steam Deck! Now I'm actually getting somewhere. For real this time. I promise. Don't believe me? Well, buy the game and a Steam Deck and test it yourself! Or better, get a Steam Deck and a Switch 2. No, HU-man Dungeons won't ever run on the Switch 2, but I'm sure you'll find other cool games there!


 More controller fixes - this time including Desktop!
 Performance improvements on the Steam Deck and systems with AMD GPU
 More destructible environments
 Another enemy - can you find her?

notes.title: Update 5/25/2025
notes.content:
Hey, I forgot to click deploy yesterday, so this weekend's build is actually only public on Monday. But it's a holiday weekend, so if you don't tell, I won't either - deal?


Audio improvements on steamdeck
Controller works again - I think
Mystery fixes!
Fourth boss actually attacks now :)

notes.title: Update 5/18/2025
notes.content:
The focus in this update was to improve performance on AMD systems that took a hit with the last two updates. If you still have performance issues you didn't used to have, please contact us.


Performance tuning
Improved enemy behavior in tight spaces
More destructible environment components
Improved boos #4

notes.title: Update 5/11/2025
notes.content:
We wish HU-mom a very happy Mother's Day! 


Boss 4 is now playable
High Scores are now shown in the main menu
New achievement icons
Fixed gloves that did not equip properly
More random critters!

notes.title: Update 5/4/2025
notes.content:
You know those witty remarks? The ones that made patch notes fun to read? Yeah... me neither... I'm just tired. When is reboot time? 


More destructible decorations
Critters now scatter from some destroyed props
Improved scoring and show previous high-scores in the menu 
Scores sync between devices
Performance improvements in areas where a lot of lava is visible

notes.title: Update 4/26/2025
notes.content:
Woohoo navigation is fixed! This time for real! We hope! 


Fixed E/Left interaction 
Many of the decorations are now destructible
Fourth boss is coming along nicely - use the typical hotkey to access
Fix for scroll speed in drop downs
Oh and we now have scores. How's that for fine print?

notes.title: Update 4/19/2025
notes.content:
Finally got to doing something new! Want to guess? Scores? ... well, yeah. 


Added Score system
Started destructible decorations
Squirrels!
Fixed a bug where player gets stuck near altars until a spell is cast.

notes.title: Update 4/13/2025
notes.content:
This update includes the 4th and 5th boss - at least their starting rooms. 


Fixed mouse controls we broke during adding controller support
Added 4th and 5th boss
Added extra achievements

notes.title: Update 4/6/2025
notes.content:
Geez - Ever programmed anything? Thousands of lines of code, hundreds of hours of work. But somewhere in the depths of the code is a tiny bug, hard to trigger, even harder to debug.

Yeah, that's not us - we screwed up the WASD navigation mode in a quite obvious way...


Fixed WASD navigation
Added that Robot Guy enemy
Added additional background audio tracks
Improved performance on low core-count systems

notes.title: Update 3/30/2025
notes.content:
Another weekend, another small update. Let me know if you like it - or even notice!


Fixed two spelling errors
Updated Unity version
Fixed turning radius on some enemies that caused them to twirl

notes.title: Update 3/23/2025
notes.content:
In this update, we focused on the ranged enemies, improving their aim, projectiles, and navigation. They can be quite a challenge now!


Ranged enemies aim & navigation
Projectile tuning
Fixed bug in navmesh causing enemies to get stuck 
Gamepad support improvements
Exploring FSR for the Steam Deck. No promises though!

notes.title: Update 3/16/2025
notes.content:
Feeling better, I decided to polish the UI a bit... It was overdue!


UI Animations are now smoother
UI audio effects implemented
Controller now default on SteamDeck

notes.title: Update 3/9/2025
notes.content:
Well, this one is a really small update - been sick most of the week. 


Fixed spelling errors. Like seriously - metar? Do we think the Compendium is a pirate?
Animation enhancements
Controller support enhancements
Reverted change to sword attack bonus

notes.title: Update 3/1/2025
notes.content:
Another week another update. Wait we already had that one. Well, it's getting harder to come up with funny stuff, maybe I should go back to the original ways and stick with the facts?


Reverted Animation changes for the green guy due to feedback
Controller defaults. This should make the game playable on the steamdeck with native controls!
Fixed leftover items in the startroom - woops, you weren't meant to see those yet!

notes.title: Update 2/23/2025
notes.content:
Well, I got so sick of working on the new controller code, so I finished it! Woooohoooooo


Controller support - obviously
Work on the 4th boss continues
Fixed bug when interacting with the horse
Fixed missing audio on flying critters

notes.title: Update 2/15/2025
notes.content:
Things are picking up Steam! Well, a steam deck at least! Controls are not final and there is a very obvious UI bug, but the frame rate is almost playable now! Wooooooooo!


Performance Improvements, specifically at very low settings
Memory needs reduced by about 20%
Attack and animation improvements on enemies - check out those slimes!
Fixed play button not highlighting when level is loaded.
87% more snark in the compendium information!

notes.title: Update 2/9/2025
notes.content:
Well... know how we said last week that you shouldn't know a difference? Yeah, those were famous last words. 


Fixed navmesh crashing the game
Fixed move speed of several enemies
Fixed UI movement
Fixed missing damage vfx

notes.title: Update 2/1/2015
notes.content: This is hopefully the most boring release we've ever published - it won't even include a list of changes and updates. The reason is that we focused on code cleanup and minor tweaks and if we did our job right, you won't even be able to tell a difference! yay!

notes.title: Update 1/26/2025
notes.content:
The fourth boss is coming along nicely! Have you beat the first three yet? If not, you better get to it! 


Fixed critters getting stuck 
Fixed critters running across lava
Fixed critters ... you get the idea
Improvements to controller support
Performance improvements on Intel Arc cards 
Unity version upgrade. We don't usually mention that, but this one fixes one of the crashes reported to us!
Improved colliders in the cave areas
Fixed audio issue for fires

notes.title: Update 1/19/2025
notes.content:
Another weekend, another update. This time we focused on the navmesh and made several much-needed enhancements:


Update to latest navmesh library version
Changed object colliders in various rooms to avoid player getting stuck on invisible objects
Optimized navmesh generation, saving up to 10 seconds when starting a new level on slower machines.
Fixed typos in the menu system
Additional controller support work

notes.title: Update 1/12/2025
notes.content:
This release finishes up several features we've been working on for a while. The rest of the time was spent playing on a Steam Deck to observe performance issues and get a hang of controllers... More work!


Finished player audio
Finished pursuit attacks
Finished level audio
Started controller support for PC and Steam Deck
Started work on boss #4!

notes.title: Update 1/5/2025
notes.content:
Geez, almost typed 2024 there! Because of the holidays, this is a small release. Enemies have a few more attacks and fixed a crash on Steam Decks. Still not supported, but we're getting closer! 


Fixed crash on Steam Deck when selecting custom configs with hard shadows
Enhanced running attacks for several enemies
Lowered HU-nan attack rate

notes.title: Update 12/29/2024
notes.content:
This update fixes a few annoying bugs and improves Steam Deck performance


Steam Deck performance is now reasonable
Fixed turn rate of several trap projectiles
Fixed HU-nan animations
Improved player run animations
Fixed bug where health aura does not vanish properly

notes.title: Updates 12/22/2024
notes.content:
A lot of work has gone into the Steam Deck version and it is almost playable... almost!


Additional attack options for enemies
Two new spells
Steam Deck game starts sometimes
Fix for navmesh in some cave rooms

notes.title: Update 12/14/2024
notes.content:
This is one of our larger weekly updates even if it looks less impressive than others. In this update, we touched almost all of our animations to make them snappier. A frame here, a 5% speedup there...


 Fixed edge case where player could move far enough to the walls where enemies could not attack
 Lots of animation changes
 More pursuit changes - the green guys now jump!
 Fixed default background audio volume for first-time players

notes.title: Update 12/1/2024
notes.content:
This is the last update in our month of performance optimizations. This time we focused on vram usage and we're happy to say that several stalls on low-vram GPUs have been fixed. 


Texture size changes for small objects
Mipmap optimizations
Enhanced projectile effects for several traps and enemies
Adjusted difficulty of the 3rd boss.

notes.title: Update 11/23/2024
notes.content:
This update fixes two crashes, one on NVidia, one on Linux. No, this doesn't mean we support the Steam Deck (yet). Additional focus was on improving performance.


Fixed performance issue when continuing after beating a boss
Fixed critter performance issue
Fixed slime low FPS behavior
Improved background audio options
Improved volume controls

notes.title: Update 11/17/2024
notes.content:
This build includes a lot of performance updates. While we can't do magic on low-end systems, this update should improve frame rates for a lot of mid-range computers.


Improved navmesh performance
Improved animation caching when you have many enemies on-screen at the same time
Improved performance of projectiles and their effects
Improved flying and roaming critter performance
Added trap hit audio
Fixed bug in introduction code causing repeated comments when playing your first level.

notes.title: Update 11/9/2024
notes.content:
The focus of this weeks release was in improving UI navigation and bug fixes.


Improved Menu UI consistency.
Background audio setting changed. As a side effect, background music may be very loud for existing users if they increased volume from the default setting. We apologize for the inconvenience. 
Navmesh update for large enemies
Tuned attack speed of the Lava Eye
Additional background audio tracks

notes.title: Update 11/2/2024
notes.content:
This update improves everybody's favorites: Traps! Some will burn your skin, others will just poke a little hole into your soul. What type is your favorite? 


Improved projectile accuracy
Added additional trap types
Traps become stronger in higher levels
Looping audio for altars fixed
Crash on low-memory GPUs fixed. You can't play the game, but at least you get a proper error message telling you what the issue is. Maybe we can reduce memory requirements in the future.

notes.title: Update 10/26/2024
notes.content:
Development is picking up again after the move to Unity 6, and we've been able to implement a bunch of new features! 


Improved background audio
Upgraded navmesh performance when multiple enemies are on the screen
Fixed for Vending Machines not dispensing proper loot
Tweaked boos #2 attack speed & damage

notes.title: Update 10/20/2024
notes.content:
This build is probably the most boring in a long time. It only includes a few small changes like adding a comma that was missing on the help screen. The majority of the word went into moving the official Unity 6 release and upgrading a few major packages like path finding and animation controllers.

If you find any regressions, please let us know in our discord!

notes.title: Update 10/13/2024
notes.content:
This update introduces actually working Vending Machines as a new and easier way to gain magical abilities!


Implemented Vending Machines across all levels
Fixed Background audio
Added additional attack animations to several enemies
The new boss is officially here!

notes.title: Update 10/6/2024
notes.content:
This update improves loading performance on AMD systems and implements several smaller bug fixes.


Updated Unity version
Improved load performance on system with AMD CPUs
Fixed light flickering in start room
Fixed Museum for bosses
Fixed audio playing after traps are destroyed
Fixed spelling errors in menu

notes.title: Update 9/28/2024
notes.content:
The focus of this update are improvements to the boss fights.


Boss Fight performance updates, especially on the 3rd boss
Audio improvements
Made boss teleportation easier to understand
Adjusted projectile sound effects
Many minor decoration updates

notes.title: Update 9/22/2024
notes.content:
This update includes a lot of smaller, visual changes as well as additional audio updates:


Improved volume controls
Additional background audio tracks
Volume normalization for many audio effects
Light distance tweaks
Light brightness adjustments
Room decorations variants in many areas
Fixed bug where HU-mom would attack too quickly upon entering her bedroom.

notes.title: Update 9/15/2024
notes.content:
Thanks to brukirk, we have identified and fixed another crash. Thank you for your patience and help!

Other changes in this update:

Background Audio improvements
Additional Enemy sound effects
Trap tuning
Adjusted difficulty of boss 3 based on feedback
Additional Quests

notes.title: Update 9/8/2024
notes.content:
Failure To Launch
A small number of users have reported that the game showed the splash screen, then starts playing music on a black screen. We have fixed this bug for the affected testers, however, if this update does not solve your issue, please contact us on Discord and provide your player.log. Thank you! 

This update focused on balancing enemies and improving their animations. Additionally, it includes 


Audio changes to many enemies
Failure to launch fix mentioned above
Performance improvements on Intel iGPU
Additional decorations and lights

notes.title: Update 8/31/2024
notes.content:
Another weekend, another small update. This time we focused on some long-standing minor bugs.


Fixed menu hang where MIN-rummic sometimes stops walking
Fixed bug where lava floor sometimes stalls
Fixed looping audio on traps
Fixed weapon trails for several swords
Fixed level generation bug that causes slow level startups
Fixed several spelling errors
Fixed male character audio

notes.title: Update 8/24/2024
notes.content:
This update focused on audio. 


Player audio changes
Traps finally have working audio
Enemy death can interrupt taunting audio
Minor menu changes

notes.content:
Fixes to Menu Screen
Improved performance on AMD cards

Improved weapons balancing

notes.content:

 Lava floor location jitter

 Crash when spamming clicks on loot

Performance Improcements
Third Boss

Quests
